raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Anthemius's origin was Italy based solely on his title as the Western Roman Emperor. While Anthemius ruled the Western Roman Empire (which included Italy), this does not necessarily mean that he was from Italy. Historical records indicate that Anthemius was of Greek origin, born in Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul, Turkey), which was part of the Eastern Roman Empire. The Planner failed to verify the actual birthplace or origin of Anthemius and prematurely associated his title with his country of origin, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
